newsitem.title: USA: NYS plans $425 mln of job creation bonds--Senate.
newsitem.headline: NYS plans $425 mln of job creation bonds--Senate.

text.p: The New York State Senate Majority Leader on Wednesday said that the preliminary budget pact for fiscal 1998 includes a $425 million bond plan to create jobs through tourism and recreation.

"And there's something that may not have been highlighted, that is going to add to job creation and economic development, there's going to be a $425 million piece, job creation piece, that will be bonded as part of legislation that takes place in this budget," Senator Joseph Bruno, R-Troy, told reporters in Albany. He added that cultural development also would qualify for funding.
A spokesman for the Senator explained that it had yet to be decided what state entity would sell the bonds.
